question: Can directly programmed fixed shared causal-relationship weights be repaired IN PLACE under new source-observed 64-variable rules without per-revision append, preserve other current contexts, and improve prediction or whole-process cost over equally informed fully fitted conventional controls?
hypothesis: A fixed global array of 65 relationship count weights plus 32 fixed nine-byte current-context programs can be updated subtract-old/add-new on true causal contradictions while retaining unaffected worlds; a matched exact GF(2) solver and optimized conventional incremental updater will likely tie predictive accuracy and capacity, so unique benefit may fail.
predecessor_evidence: FKP-08 PR #1099, exact source e15c9588a29c942ef4f9710a981e7a60220f6546; qualified 81d60026c066c1160aa60559170c06cf01677353; Linux/Windows 54/54 inherited tests; original DEV NO_GO: direct 0.75952, strong exact marginal 0.79289, conventional delta exact tie.

Separate unrun FKP-07 shared-weight branch 06fff14a9a49c2503505de364ad04a5851bb0e5f uses 4-parent finite public grammar and colliding experiment ID: do not consume or relabel its original DEV.

inputs.name: FKP-09 synthetic source protocol (unopened original DEV)

seeds.out_of_family_dev: 980..987 threshold response, never part of fit; zero false-confident accepted laws

frozen_design.split: Each world has 64 directly actionable binary input concepts. A 64-bit intervention x produces one binary causal consequence y=parity(mask & x) XOR bias. Source-owner generates hidden arbitrary 64-bit masks and biases per world using frozen HMAC key; learner sees only actions and observed consequence. Distinct revision worlds replace same 8 context slots with new hidden masks. Eight out-of-family threshold laws are held separate and must trigger contradiction/abstention rather than false confident generalization. All public action pools consist of 128 distinct 64-bit interventions, and each evaluation set is 512 disjoint 64-bit interventions. Sources, secret parameters and held labels never passed to any arm. Random action order frozen from source context ID, not outcome.
frozen_design.ordering: Prereg commit precedes source implementation and every original evaluation. First run source-safe fixtures 700..703 ONLY. Freeze source, tests, candidate and controls on exact SHA + G29 Linux/Windows full regression before ONE original DEV 900..923, then 940..947, then public negative 980..987. All predictions sealed before held outcome access. All equal-information arms consume identical paid action/outcome transcripts at 16/32/64/128 prefixes. Results not used for retuning.
frozen_design.data_budget: 24 initial +8 revision +8 out-of-family =40 worlds; each at most 128 authentic action/consequence observations, 5,120 paid interventions total; each evaluated on 512 disjoint held interventions, 20,480 held predictions per arm. Only one original DEV use; no protected first-use.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 standard library only, deterministic 64-variable elimination with 65 unknown bits, 128 source observations/world, max 32 fixed context slots, no paid APIs/GPU or local owner runner. Measured CPU+wall from source creation through prediction, fit, restore, reference controls and scoring. Separate Linux and Windows regression required.
frozen_design.capacity: Fixed 32 context slots x 9 bytes (65-bit parity program), 65 unsigned 16-bit shared activation/count weights, plus 32-bit slot occupancy =422 raw bytes; checksum/header on top; no new version-specific program slot, no growing learned relationship table, no native model mutation.
frozen_design.evaluator: At each 16/32/64/128 budget, submit predicted consequence vectors for 512 disjoint held actions before source-owner scoring. Full-budget unknown law program (65 bits) may be recoverable; if contradictions or rank-deficiency, abstain. On 8 repaired slots verify same fixed byte capacity, only changed slots affect global counts, unaffected 16 of 24 slots exactly preserved, replay-rebuilt shared counts bit equal. Out-of-family 8 threshold response worlds must be detected as inconsistent and abstained. Exact cold snapshot restore, corruption rejection, invalid action and negative controls. Estimate uncertainty paired by worlds; independent external scientific qualification not included.

controls: A: direct 65-bit causal-program inference from actual paid observations by frozen GF(2) elimination plus subtract-old/add-new 65 shared count weights in same numeric array; no separate version slot; no hidden source mask
B: independently coded full exact GF(2) solver on same paid transcripts; conventional optimally trained parity-rule inference (strong prediction control)
C: independently coded conventional incremental sufficient-statistic matrix with identical context slots, action data and count capacity (strong time/storage control), must not be excluded for tying

D: independently rebuilt conventional replay from all current 32 context programs; full history-based reference for fixed global counts and one isolated resource comparator (weak speed reference if incremental C ties)
E: naive one-context destructive global overwrite, retention diagnostic only; fixed old belief or masked-random guess as negative
F: source-private true-law oracle for post hoc source-identifiability only, never supplied to learner or fit
G: outside-family threshold and shuffled observed action/outcome controls, require abstention and disclose confidence failure
metrics: Engineering: 128-action full-rank source 32/32 initial/revised parity worlds, >=0.99 mean 512-held accuracy; 8/8 revised current slots repaired, 16/16 unrelated current contexts bit-identical; direct shared counts bit-equal independent replay; fixed 422 raw bytes plus separately measured checksum and CPU/wall; 100% cold recovery and corruption rejection.
Negative: 8/8 out-of-family threshold worlds rejected/abstained and zero confidently wrong accepted predictions. Honest abstention counted separately from incorrect predictions.

Scientific unique gain candidate: >=0.05 absolute held accuracy over strongest equal-data fully fitted independent exact GF(2) control with context-bootstrap CI lower bound>0, OR within 0.005 accuracy and >=2x whole-process CPU+wall improvement on both Linux and Windows compared to best optimized equal-capacity conventional incremental control C, including data acquisition and validation; no other acceptance criterion.

Strong conventional exact tie, absence of 2x whole-process gain, any family-specific positive, or source-blinding failure means no native scientific superiority; independent blinded source-family replication and native-owner science acceptance still mandatory even if public DEV signals positive.

classification_rules.supported: DEV_MECHANISM only when exact full-rule identification, 8/8 in-place atomic repairs, 16/16 preserved unrelated contexts, global replay agreement, bound/cold/tamper/source negative controls PASS. No SCIENTIFIC_PASS from public DEV alone.
classification_rules.mixed: Mechanism functional but same-data exact GF2 or equally optimized conventional incremental matched performance/cost (or known parity family restricts transfer) => DEV_MIXED_NO_NATIVE.
classification_rules.negative: Any target source rank deficiency, failure to restore, added version slots, collateral forgetting, 128-action held accuracy <.99, negative outside-family overconfidence, or missing full costs => DEV_NO_GO.
classification_rules.invalid: Owner-private hidden labels/mask read by learner; original DEV inspected before qualified source+tests code freeze; protected primary opened; source/actions budget drift; protocol retuned after scores; identity collision; full regression absent but called engineering PASS.

prohibited_after_primary_run: Changing algorithms, baselines, thresholds, seeds, family, budget, actions or data splits on scored DEV
Treating original DEV as fresh science when reproduced
Protected cohorts or private owner evaluation without separate authority
Native/Yggdrasil accepted main or runner changes
Other projects, existing schedulers, paid APIs, or automated successor launch
